name: Lease Deed / Rent Agreement
summary: Used when immovable property is rented or leased for a fixed term with rent and conditions.

name: Deed of Family Trust
summary: Used to create a private trust for managing family property or assets.

name: Separation Agreement (Husband & Wife)
summary: Used when spouses decide to live separately without immediate divorce.

name: Deed of Adoption
summary: Used to legally adopt a child and transfer parental rights.

name: Deed of Family Settlement
summary: Used to amicably divide inherited family property among heirs.

name: Legal Notice for Property Partition
summary: Used to formally demand partition of jointly owned property.

name: Letter to Builder for Delay in Possession
summary: Used by a buyer to demand possession or action due to construction delay.

name: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
summary: Used to protect confidential business or technical information.

name: Office Services Agreement / Business Centre Agreement
summary: Used when a business centre provides office facilities and services to clients on a contractual basis.

name: Loan Agreement with Security
summary: Used for inter-corporate deposits or loans secured by pledge of securities or assets.

name: Legal Notice for Recovery of Outstanding Payment
summary: Used to formally demand payment of outstanding dues from a debtor before filing suit.

name: Anticipatory Bail Petition Application
summary: Used to seek pre-arrest bail protection from Sessions Court or High Court in anticipation of arrest.

name: Trademark License Agreement
summary: Used when a trademark owner licenses a manufacturer to produce goods bearing their trademark.

name: License to Use Copyright Agreement
summary: Used to grant permission to use copyrighted material for a specific purpose and period.

name: Legal Notice for Defamation
summary: Used to demand compensation for damage to reputation caused by false and defamatory statements.

name: Legal Notice for Cancellation of Power of Attorney
summary: Used to formally revoke a Power of Attorney and demand cessation of all actions under it.
